title: Long lists and boards open straight away, and finished work keeps scrolling
description: A list with hundreds of tasks used to take several seconds to open, because every row was built at once. Only the rows you can see are drawn now, so a big list opens as fast as a small one. On the board, the finished columns no longer stop at twelve cards: scroll down and more load.
items: A 388-task list went from up to eight seconds to about a quarter of a second
The board's Completed columns load twenty more cards each time you reach the bottom, and the heading shows the full count
Your browser's find-in-page only searches the rows on screen — scroll, or use the list's filters, to find the rest
